seo.title: Projects
seo.description: There are most of the projects that I was involved in or created, they are mostly personal hobby ones.

diary.title: Web Diary Prototype
diary.description: Graduation thesis project on the development of an online portal of an electronic diary.

rumc.title: Ru-Minecraft Redesign
rumc.description: Performed a redesign of an old template and migrated code from old JS and CSS to TypeScript, PostCSS, Tailwind, and SCSS technology stack.

f2d.title: Fabric2Discord
f2d.description: A modification for the game Minecraft that adds interconnectivity between in-game chat and Discord.

premid.title: PreMiD
premid.description: Responsible for the design and development of functionality for the website with subsequent maintenance.

homabric.title: Homabric
homabric.description: A modification for the game Minecraft that adds an advanced house system.

agora.title: Project Agora
agora.description: Originally an experimental project to test the workability of Preact and JSX inside a userscript.

renameit.title: RenameIt
renameit.description: A modification for the game Minecraft that allows you to change the names and captions of items.

vkdiary.title: VKDiary
vkdiary.description: Auxiliary development for the electronic diary project. Represents a bot for VK, which knows how to notify students in advance about the imminent start of classes.

iris.title: Iris Shaders
iris.description: An attempt to rework the old Iris Shaders template using new technologies.

localized-soundcloud.title: localized-soundcloud
localized-soundcloud.description: A project for learning how to use MutationObserver. Translates elements of the SoundCloud site into the selected language and responds to DOM changes.

vdiscorde.title: VDiscorde
vdiscorde.description: An attempt to develop the first bot that displays information about VK users and allows you to link a page to your Discord account.
